_comment: Homelab-maintained declarative egg derived from pelican-eggs/games-standalone Mindustry.
name: Homelab Mindustry acceptance
author: sir3lit@gmail.com
description: Native AMD64/ARM64 acceptance workload. Derived from pelican-eggs/games-standalone Mindustry; pinned v160.7 with checksum and multiarch image digests.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
curl -fL --retry 3 -o server-release.jar https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry/releases/download/v160.7/server-release.jar
echo "f7b899a4038b95b14a824d5f8993984f79d73baa3254c385b6538327f9c0befd  server-release.jar" | sha256sum -c -

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The server name that shows up in the server list

variables.name: Map Name
variables.description:
Default Maps Available: Ancient Caldera, Fork, Fortress, Glacier, Islands, Labyrinth, Maze, Shattered, Tendrils, Triad, Veins, Wasteland.

(Default: Tendrils)
